drills.title: Doorway Slice (Custom Example)

setup.position: Stand one step back from a doorframe, target visible only once you slice past the edge.

drills.objective: Slice a doorway at compressed ready and break a clean shot the moment the target clears the frame.
steps: Start at compressed ready, one step back from the frame.
On the beep, lateral-step to open the angle; muzzle leads your eyes.
Extend as the target clears the frame and press one shot.
Hold follow-through, then return to compressed ready.
errors: Extending before the target is visible
